## Report: subtree spike — feasible, 12 mechanical findings, no architectural blocker · `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU` · 2026-10-24T16:06Z

**Branch:** `claude/project-thread-dwhq6r` (pushed; no PR — see "not measured"). Four commits on top of the full objectui history: `2bc1807eae` subtree add of objectui `main` 0984c77e1 (#13445, pin already at the 18.1.0 release commit), `ec74d9ecfa` workspace wiring + single lockfile, `4f3149d015` one react type line, `3efb112efb` Console Vite chunk tests made workspace-aware. Base: objectstack `main` dc6c7ee73.

### 维护者速读

可行，没有架构级障碍。objectui 全历史并入 `ui/` 2 秒、0 文件冲突；单 lockfile 一次装通（1 分 12 秒）；Console 及 72 个依赖包能通过根 turbo 构建，产物通过本仓的"单 zod 金丝雀"；objectui 单测在合并后的根下能跑。要在正式切换前做掉的 12 项都是机械性的（下表），其中 3 项 spike 里已顺手修了。两个要你知道的数：Console/app-shell 的 tsc 需要 ≥4 GB 堆；正式切换 PR 有 259 万行变更，按 Tier H 规则只能由维护者人工合并。建议直接进子卡 2。完整中文报告：项目库 `d1-merge/spike-report.md`。

### Measurements

| Item | Reading |
|---|---|
| objectui full history (`git fetch --unshallow`) | 8 s, 12 330 commits, 191 MiB pack |
| `git subtree add --prefix=ui` (history kept, no `--squash`) | 2 s, 0 file conflicts (everything lands under `ui/`) |
| `ui/` source size (no node_modules) | 147 MB; merged local pack 772 MiB |
| single-lockfile `pnpm install` (cold store, not frozen) | 1 m 12 s; warm re-install 40–48 s |
| merged `pnpm-lock.yaml` | 963 KB, 4 217 package entries (2 813 objectstack + 3 607 objectui before; ~2 200 deduped) |
| `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'` (72 packages, cold, 4 vCPU) | 7 m 31 s (68/70 green; after the react fix the rest 3 m 15 s) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build` | 2 m 01 s with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144`; dist 64 MB, 2 376 chunks |
| `scripts/build-console.sh --check-single-zod ui/apps/console/dist/assets` | ✓ exactly one zod literal (4.6.5) in `vendor-objectstack-*.js` |
| objectui vitest `--project unit packages/core packages/i18n` from `ui/` | 270 files in 26 s; 3 files fail, all of one kind (rows 1 and 6 below) |
| full merge diff (`dispatch-gates --tier` on this branch) | 9 267 paths, 2 589 924 changed lines — ⛔ OVER the 3 000-line human-merge threshold: the cutover PR is a Tier H landing (maintainer merge) |

### What the wiring commit does (reusable by the cutover script)

1. `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: add `ui`, `ui/packages/*`, `ui/apps/*`, `ui/examples/*`; carry objectui's security floor overrides (qs, shell-quote, tmp, uuid — dompurify already pinned here) and its `@radix-ui/react-focus-scope@1.1.16` patch into root `patches/`.
2. `ui/package.json`: drop the `pnpm` field (seven `file:.objectstack-pin/*` pins and the react 19.2.8 pins) and the `preinstall` pin check.
3. 32 objectui manifests: 40 `"@objectstack/*": "^18.0.0-next.N"` ranges → `workspace:^` (publishes as `^<version>`; one fixed group makes the floor the version itself). `ui/packages/core/node_modules/@objectstack/spec` now symlinks to `packages/spec`. The card asked for npm range + root overrides instead; `workspace:^` was chosen because pnpm 10 only reads `overrides` from `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and the fixed-group ruling makes a floating range meaningless — either shape works mechanically.
4. Remove `ui/pnpm-lock.yaml` and `ui/pnpm-workspace.yaml` (nested roots are ignored); park `ui/turbo.json` as `ui/turbo.objectui.json` (a nested `turbo.json` without `extends` is a package-config error).

### Findings for sub-issues 2–5

| # | Finding | Evidence | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Pin plumbing to delete:** 191 objectstack files reference `.objectui-sha`/`build-console.sh` (7 workflows: ci, cut-rc, lint, release, scheduled-full-run-card, showcase-smoke, spec-shape-gate); 33 objectui files reference `.objectstack-pin`/`.objectstack-sha` (13 workflows); 12 objectui files implement a semver "spec floor" that `workspace:^` voids — one unit test already fails on it | grep counts; `normalize-list-view.declaredSpecFloor-9012.test.ts` | 3, 4 |
| 2 | **tsc heap:** `@object-ui/app-shell` and the Console `tsc` OOM at the default ~2 GB heap; with 6 GB they use 2.3 GB (3 574 files, 1.15 M lines of `.d.ts`). Standalone objectui sat just under the default | build logs | 2: `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` in those build scripts or CI |
| 3 | **react line:** `@objectstack/client-react` wants ^19.3.0, objectui pins 19.2.8 → two `@types/react`, `plugin-view`'s d.ts build fails. Fixed in the spike by root overrides to 19.3.0 | build log | 2: bump objectui's 31 manifests in place |
| 4 | **zod ranges:** 5 objectui manifests declare ^4.4.3/^4.6.1, objectstack ^4.6.5; the lock holds 4.6.1 and 4.6.5 but the Console bundle carries one (canary passes) | lock + canary | 2: align to ^4.6.5 |
| 5 | **Console Vite config matches `@objectstack/*` by node_modules path:** workspace links resolve to `<root>/packages/<name>/dist/…`, so the vendor group test, the spec counter-probe and the lazy-linter guard all missed and the build failed. Fixed (+14 lines) by adding the workspace prefix; `scripts/vite-objectstack-client-dist.ts` carries the same assumption, unexercised | `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` | fixed; 2 checks the client-dist helper |
| 6 | **"I am the repo root" assumption:** 71 objectui files locate the root via `.git` / `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` / `pnpm-workspace.yaml` / find-up; merged, that is the objectstack root. One unit test already reads `<root>/packages/core/...` and fails | `filter-icontains-alignment-8976.test.ts` | 2: one `uiRoot()` helper |
| 7 | **turbo:** nested `ui/turbo.json` cannot stay as is; task names differ (`type-check` vs `typecheck`, `test:dist`, `lint`); its `globalDependencies` point at `.objectstack-sha` | turbo 2.11 | 2: root `turbo.json` absorbs the ui tasks |
| 8 | **Duplicated governance under `ui/`:** `.github` (28 workflows), `.claude` (8 hooks vs 12 at root), `.changeset` (83 pending changesets + its own 40-package fixed group), `AGENTS.md` (630 lines vs 1 117), `skills/`, `scripts/` (136 vs 288; lockfile-integrity/dedupe, bash32-floor, entry-guard duplicated by name) | ls counts | 3 (changeset group, ADR), 4 (workflows), 2 (AGENTS) |
| 9 | **pre-push hook refuses the imported history:** `check:commit-card-trailers` judged 3 668 objectui commits (`Fixes #n` in messages). No bypass needed: `git remote add objectui … && git fetch objectui main` makes them "reachable from a remote-tracking ref", which the gate excludes by design. CI runs only the self-test, so the cutover PR is not red on this | hook output | 5: write into the cutover script |
| 10 | **Stale local `main` trap:** the sibling objectui checkout's `main` was 28 commits behind; the first import used it and `@object-ui/auth` failed TS2741 on the `external` org role — the two-repo drift in miniature. The cutover script must take the sha from `git ls-remote` | first build log | 5 |
| 11 | **liveness and lockstep:** 34 liveness ledger files mention objectui; `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` records "one objectui revision" | ls/grep | 4: in-repo paths |
| 12 | **install hooks:** objectui's root `preinstall` pin check, `setup` and `objectstack:build` scripts are dead after the merge; `preinstall` removed in the spike | `ui/package.json` | 2 |

Only remaining peer warning after install: objectstack's pre-existing `ioredis-mock` vs ioredis 6.

### Not measured, and why

- **CI wall-clock for the three PR classes** (`ui/` only, `packages/spec` only, both): no PR was opened. A 2.59 M-line PR exists only to read CI, and it trips the Tier H changed-lines gate and every path-filtered workflow at once; the local readings above are the substitute. Sub-issue 2 measures CI on its own branch once path filters exist.
- **`--squash` variant:** not run; the tree is identical, only commit metadata differs, and the ruling keeps history.
- **Full `pnpm typecheck` / `pnpm test` across `ui/`:** blocked by finding 7 (task names) — ran the unit project for two packages instead.

Done when, checked: branch pushed ✓ · no PR ✓ · report on the card ✓ · nothing changed on `main` ✓.
